toad.dialogue.warp_core_low: This system asks for a Warp Core of tier %1$s; yours is tier %2$s.
toad.dialogue.star.red: A red dwarf: dim and cold. Bring warm gear.
toad.dialogue.star.lava: An ember star: hot and volcanic.
toad.dialogue.star.blue: A blue star: rare ores, and danger.
toad.dialogue.guide.tier.0: Welcome! Coal and copper are all you need to start.
toad.dialogue.guide.tier.1: Iron is plentiful past the first rings. Build a Ship Table.
toad.dialogue.guide.tier.2: Diamonds sleep deep; bring a better engine.
toad.dialogue.guide.tier.3: The cold and the heat begin here: pack the right gear.
toad.dialogue.guide.tier.4: Few return from this far. Check every module twice.
toad.dialogue.guide.tier.5: Nothing is ordinary this far out.
toad.dialogue.miner.tier.2: Dig deep for diamonds and emeralds.
toad.dialogue.miner.tier.3: Quartz and amethyst glitter in the dark.
toad.dialogue.miner.tier.4: Ancient debris is for the brave.
toad.dialogue.explorer.tier.0: Stay near home until you know the way.
toad.dialogue.explorer.tier.1: A compass and a map go a long way.
toad.dialogue.explorer.tier.2: The next rings are wide; plan your warp.
toad.dialogue.explorer.tier.3: Mind the stars: each system is its own world.
toad.dialogue.explorer.tier.4: The map ends where you do not.
toad.dialogue.technician.tier.0: Every ship starts with a hull.
toad.dialogue.technician.tier.2: A rudder helps in tight places.
toad.dialogue.technician.tier.3: A bigger cabin carries more crew.
toad.dialogue.technician.tier.5: Nothing flies this far without all modules.
toad.dialogue.mailman.tier.0: I carry little yet, come back later.
toad.dialogue.mailman.tier.1: Letters from the next planets are on their way.
toad.dialogue.mailman.tier.2: Parcels from afar have strange stones.
toad.dialogue.mailman.tier.4: Only the boldest get my mail.
toad.dialogue.mailman.tier.5: I deliver anywhere, for a price.
message.galaxycraft.ship.needs_engine_ca: A ship needs an engine and a cabin

message.galaxycraft.pad.ground: A landing pad goes on the ground: point at it
message.galaxycraft.pad.placed: Landing pad down. Fly near it and hold the Ship: Descend / Dock key (Z by default) to dock (right click picks another)
message.galaxycraft.pad.near: Landing pad %s of %s, %s blocks away: right click for the next, hold the Ship: Descend / Dock key to dock
message.galaxycraft.ship.crowded: Too close to another ship or pad
message.galaxycraft.toad.no_world: There is no world to put a Toad in.
message.galaxycraft.toad.no_ground: There is no ground ahead for a Toad.
toad.hud.pick: Press 1-4, or Up / Down and Enter
toad.dialogue.place.tier.0: This is the quiet ring around home: friendly ground and gentle skies.
toad.dialogue.place.tier.1: The first rings out from home. Plenty of iron, and fewer visitors.
toad.dialogue.place.tier.2: The middle ring. The ground is richer, and the sky is not as kind.
toad.dialogue.place.tier.3: The far ring: heat and cold are real here, and so are the rewards.
toad.dialogue.place.tier.4: Deep space. Few have been this far; the ores are rare and strange.
toad.dialogue.place.tier.5: The edge of what anyone has charted. Be ready for anything.
toad.dialogue.place.visited: You have been here before, so the way back is free.
toad.dialogue.place.new: New ground for you. Mind the Warp Core's reach before you come back.
toad.dialogue.advice.module: Build the %1$s for your ship first.
toad.dialogue.guide.advice.0: Gather coal and copper, then build a Ship Table at home.
toad.dialogue.guide.advice.1: Find iron on the first rings. A better engine reaches farther.
toad.dialogue.guide.advice.2: Look for diamonds deep down, and bring gear for the next ring.
toad.dialogue.guide.advice.3: Pack warm and cool gear; the next systems have real weather.
toad.dialogue.guide.advice.4: Check every module twice before you warp this far.
toad.dialogue.guide.advice.5: There is no map past here. Write down what you find.
toad.dialogue.miner.advice.0: Dig for coal and cobblestone around the huts and caves nearby.
toad.dialogue.miner.advice.1: Try the hills of the first rings: iron shows up in plain sight.
toad.dialogue.miner.advice.2: Dig deep on the bigger planets for diamonds and emeralds.
toad.dialogue.miner.advice.3: Blue stars hide quartz and amethyst. Take a good pickaxe.
toad.dialogue.miner.advice.4: Ancient debris lies deepest under lava stars. Do not rush.
toad.dialogue.miner.advice.5: The rarest ores are on the farthest planets. Bring a pickel.
toad.dialogue.explorer.advice.0: Walk the whole home planet first; every biome has its uses.
toad.dialogue.explorer.advice.1: Warp to the nearest new star and look for the huts of my friends.
toad.dialogue.explorer.advice.2: Pick a star color you have not seen and see what its planets are.
toad.dialogue.explorer.advice.3: Red dwarfs are cold, ember stars hot. Choose the one you can bear.
toad.dialogue.explorer.advice.4: Go where the stars are blue; very few have returned with maps.
toad.dialogue.explorer.advice.5: Keep going. Somebody has to chart it.
toad.dialogue.technician.advice.0: Build the Ship Table and your hull. Everything else follows.
toad.dialogue.technician.advice.1: An engine module first: it sets how far a warp can take you.
toad.dialogue.technician.advice.2: A rudder and a bigger cabin make long trips easier.
toad.dialogue.technician.advice.3: Get a Warp Core: unvisited systems open only to it.
toad.dialogue.technician.advice.4: A better Warp Core, and every module checked, before anything else.
toad.dialogue.technician.advice.5: Nothing flies out here without all its modules. I mean it.
toad.dialogue.mailman.advice.0: Come back after you have visited a hut or two: I will have mail.
toad.dialogue.mailman.advice.1: Mail from the next planets reaches me soon. Ask again later.
toad.dialogue.mailman.advice.2: Parcels from afar carry strange stones. Bring emeralds.
toad.dialogue.mailman.advice.3: Rare deliveries need rare payment. Bring a few gems.
toad.dialogue.mailman.advice.4: Only the boldest get my best mail. Show me something from far away.
toad.dialogue.mailman.advice.5: I deliver anywhere, for a price. Where is your next stop?

message.galaxycraft.star.alone: Launch Star "%s": no partner yet. Right click to change its code; a star with the same code on another planet links to it
message.galaxycraft.star.crowded: Too close to another Launch Star
message.galaxycraft.star.hint: Linked. Hold Shift to be launched, right click to change the code
message.galaxycraft.star.named: Launch Star code is now "%s"; a star with the same code on another planet links to it

screen.galaxycraft.star.info: Stars with the same code on different planets are linked.
